primary: Table II row read as Table I

themes.theme: Table II row read as Table I
themes.root_cause: A derivative row is reported as non-derivative, usually with the UNDERLYING security as its title; nothing in the flattened text says which table a row came from.
A Table II holdings line (exercise and expiry dates, no transaction) is reported as a transaction, with the exercisable date as its 'transaction date'.
